title: Lodging reimbursed up to per diem (300% under actual expense)
description: Lodging is reimbursed at actual cost up to the locality per-diem lodging ceiling. If lodging at per diem is unavailable, the agency may authorize actual expense up to 300% of the applicable per diem.

title: M&IE first/last day at 75% and provided-meal deductions
description: On the first and last day of travel, M&IE is 75% of the locality rate. When a meal is provided by the government or included in a registration fee, the corresponding amount from the M&IE breakdown table is deducted.

title: CONUS lodging taxes reimbursed separately
description: In CONUS, lodging taxes are not included in the per-diem rate and are reimbursable as a miscellaneous travel expense, limited to taxes on the reimbursable lodging cost.

title: Receipts required for lodging and expenses over $75
description: A lodging receipt is required, as are receipts for any authorized expense over $75, or an acceptable written explanation why a receipt is unavailable.

title: No mixing lodging and M&IE allowances
description: The FTR does not allow shifting unused lodging per diem to M&IE or vice versa. Lodging is reimbursed at actual cost up to the ceiling; M&IE is a flat allowance.

title: Day travel over 12 hours eligible for 75% M&IE
description: For one-day travel away from the official station lasting more than 12 hours, the traveler is entitled to 75% of the applicable M&IE rate.
